standard: pass = each documented fact is stated (values included) in the note as the model sees it, no missing or absent fact is stated, contradictions are in order, and a careful reviewer reading only the note and the criteria would give every criterion the label's status; fail = the note's own text supports another status for some criterion, whether the writer or the fact sheet caused it. A failed note leaves the set (training/generate/v3/build.py).
